submission_note: tip-continuation of the public USGS/INGENIOUS fault catalogue; 44923 dots at 4px spacing, NaN outside footprint
hypothesis: H-SASS3-J: unmapped faults continue mapped structures past tips and across step-overs
mechanism: extrapolate each mapped catalogue cell along the local strike (PCA of its 8 nearest catalogue cells) for up to 8 steps, reject cells within 200 m of mapped ground, then thin to the dot budget that maximises HOLDOUT-DTI
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: linear topographic artefacts (roads, fence lines, agricultural edges, survey swaths) and basin-axis gravity gradients that continue fault trends without a fault

holdout.label: HOLDOUT-DTI (catalogue-recovery surrogate v1)
holdout.evaluator: catalogue-recovery-surrogate-v1 (exact official DTI equations, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, R=3 px)
holdout.selection_basis: E2 sweep over spacing and budget on the fixed blocked split (see sweep rows)
holdout.budget_override_reason: holdout flat 24k-45k; explicit budget, not holdout-selected
holdout.not_a_score_because: withheld cells are catalogue faults; the scored set is new faults absent from the catalogue

submission_scope.scope: the 9 focus-site historical best files + the GEMSDOE32 0.2778 field + the 5 rasters this repo has published (11 real submitted fields, all SHA-verified locally)

calibration_lattice.note: the 13GEMSDOE calibration lattice has 206,895 positive cells (4.0% of the footprint) and puts a dot within 3 px of every footprint cell, so the literal forward rule cannot be satisfied by ANY field that predicts inside the footprint; it is a synthetic halo field, not a submission. Flagged as irregularity IR-SASS3-90.

registry.full_pool_note: the 2,915-file registry pool is not present in this workspace; scope is stated

supersedes.reason: IR-SASS3-78: that build filled the outside of the footprint with 0.0; the official text says outside is null or nan and the shared validator fails finite-outside files closed. The dot set is identical (same seed and budget); only the outside convention changed.

provenance.catalogue: evidence/gsd_hua_map_preview.npz:catalogue_ds (400 m decimation of the public USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue that ships as existing_faults.tif)
